notes: Direct fetch worked with no WAF/blocking (HTTP 200 throughout, robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow). Westside is a Tata/Trent apparel retailer; its 'Home' nav section is dominated by textiles (Cushions, Bedsheets, Pillow Cases, Duvets, Table Linen, Towels/Mats) and functional goods (Kitchenware, Water Bottles, Bath storage baskets/soap dishes) which are out of scope and were excluded wholesale after title-scanning confirmed no decor content. Exact qty for every included leaf was derived from the Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json full listing (paginated, not the storefront widget count, per Rule 1), then title-scanned to strip out-of-scope items from mixed roll-ups per Rule 0/mixed-rollup guidance: 'Decor' collection (61 raw) excluded 1 artificial-plant item (Green Artificial Trailing Monstera Bush) -> 60; 'Candle | Stands' (30 raw) excluded 1 fragranced item (Ritual Fragrance Tealights, Home Fragrance) -> 29; 'Flowers | Vases' (37 raw) is almost entirely artificial flowers/potted-flower arrangements (excluded, 26 items) leaving 11 genuine vases -> 11; 'Plants | Planters' (45 raw) is almost entirely artificial plants (excluded, 28 items) leaving 17 empty decorative ceramic/metal pots and planters -> 17; 'Lights | Lanterns' (14 raw) is 100% genuine lighting fixtures/lanterns -> 14 (no room-based nav to traverse, this is the whole lighting catalogue - confirmed via nav dump, no other lighting collection exists). 'Serveware' under Kitchen (76 raw) excluded 8 cutlery/flatware/trivet items (spoons, forks, trivet - kitchen tools per scope exclusion) leaving 68 genuine tableware/dinnerware/glassware/serving-tray pieces -> 68. Verified via handle-level set intersection that none of the 6 harvested collections share any product (0 overlaps across 263 raw products), so no double-counting. Confirmed via robots-compliant search (site search q=mirror, q=wall+clock, q=wall+art) that Westside Home has NO mirror product line (the 71 'mirror' search hits are all apparel with mirror-work embroidery or fuzzy-matched glassware, zero actual mirrors) and NO wall clocks (only the 3 table clocks already counted inside the Decor bucket, confirmed via dedicated wall-clock search returning exactly those 3). Explicitly excluded as out-of-scope: Kitchenware (83, 100% functional storage/cookware/bar tools), Bottles (12, 100% functional drinkware), Bath Accessories (19, laundry/storage baskets + soap dish/dispenser - functional bath storage not genuine decor), Tea|Coffee, Table Linen, Bedsheets, Pillow Cases, Duvets, Cushions, Towels|Mats (all textile/functional), Home Fragrance collection (diffusers/incense), Plants|Planters artificial-plant items, Gift Shop page (Holiday & Gift), and the aggregator/brand pages collections/home, collections/living, collections/kitchen, collections/bed, collections/bath, collections/westside-home, new-in-home (all Shop-All/View-All/New-In style listings, never extracted per rule). Duplicate-company check: Westside Home is a distinct standalone Indian apparel-led retailer's home line (Trent/Tata group); no other company in this project's list matches this brand or domain - not a duplicate.
